clusters stimulate foreign direct investments inflow and foreign direct investments have positive impact on labor market.

the cluster initiatives are a panacea for economic and social development of less developed regions, and foreign direct investments have a positive impact on the labor market.

the question whether foreign investments are an effective instrument in reducing unemployment and increasing the competitiveness of the local economy in less developed regions.
the impact of cluster initiatives on FDI inflow and the impact of FDI on labor market in less developed regions of Poland.
the impact of FDI on employment in less developed regions of Poland.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the clusters have a significant impact on FDI inflow, and FDI inflow has a significant impact on labor market in less developed regions.
the inflow of foreign direct investments in less developed regions of Poland has a positive effect on the development of the labor market and the economy of these regions.
clusters and FDI are important factors of regional development and they should be supported by the state and regional authorities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inflow of foreign direct investments is a significant factor stimulating economic growth, and in the context of clusters, it is a very effective tool to reduce unemployment.
clusters are an important tool for economic growth and foreign direct investments are an important factor in the development of less developed regions.
clusters and foreign capital investments can be a panacea for the labor market in less developed regions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of clusters in less developed regions is a good way of attracting foreign capital and stimulating economic development and employment in these regions.
the clusters are the most effective tool for attracting foreign capital, but the inflow of foreign direct investments is not the panacea of labor market problems.
the development of clusters in Poland is not yet at a level that would significantly affect the level of employment and unemployment.
